opportunities.title: Research Fund

amount.raw: up to £5000 of funding for 12 months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC, or Fellow FRSC) holding an independent research post; must not hold another active Research Fund grant; limited to one application per department with Head of Department support.
opportunities.summary: Supports RSC members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early career researchers. Covers chemicals/equipment, consumables, software licences, equipment repairs and equipment access. 2026 Round 2 opens 12 October 2026 and closes 30 November 2026.

opportunities.title: Researcher Development and Travel Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Partner Scientist, Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC, or Fellow FRSC) who are PhD students in the chemical sciences or researchers within 10 years of leaving full-time education.
opportunities.summary: Supports PhD students and early career scientists to undertake an activity that develops their research career, such as presenting at conferences, attending training courses or organising scientific meetings. 2026 Round 4 opens 14 September 2026 and closes 19 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be aged 18 and over, be a UK or Republic of Ireland resident (with UK/ROI address and bank account) or apply on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK or ROI, and have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Funds chemistry-based public engagement and outreach projects that connect communities with the chemical sciences, including developing chemists' engagement skills, engaging school students and public audiences, and providing under-represented audiences with chemistry engagement opportunities. Open throughout 2026 with rolling deadlines; final deadline 2 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Grants for Carers
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be a chemist based in the UK or Ireland, or hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years if based outside these countries, and incur additional caring expenses while attending a chemistry-related event.
opportunities.summary: Supports carers to attend a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event by covering additional costs of care they usually provide. Rolling application, up to £1,200 per year.

opportunities.title: Accessibility Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be a chemist based in the UK or Ireland, or hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years if based outside these countries, and require support or assistance relating to a disability, impairment or health condition to attend a chemistry-related event.
opportunities.summary: Supports chemists with disabilities and ongoing health conditions to attend chemistry-related meetings, conferences, workshops or professional development events by covering costs of specific support such as accessible travel, personal assistance, communication support and assistive software/hardware. Rolling application, up to £1,200 per year.
